items.stem: A stakeholder only needs to view reports in a workspace and change nothing. Which workspace role follows least privilege?

options.rationale: Correct: the Viewer role grants read access without edit or management rights.
Admin grants full control, far beyond read-only needs.
Member can edit and share content, which exceeds view-only needs.
Contributor can create and edit items, which a viewer does not need.

items.explanation: Correct: the Viewer role grants read access without edit or management rights.

items.stem: In Microsoft Fabric, what is a capacity primarily used as?

options.text: The compute resource and isolation boundary for workloads
options.rationale: Correct: capacities are the compute resources used by all workloads and can isolate compute (for example by DTAP).

options.text: A security boundary that controls data access
options.rationale: Data access is controlled by workspace roles and item security, not the capacity.
Workspaces organize content; capacities provide their compute.
A capacity is infrastructure, not a report.

items.explanation: Correct: capacities are the compute resources used by all workloads and can isolate compute (for example by DTAP).

items.stem: Which TWO are governance capabilities surfaced in the OneLake catalog Govern section? (Select TWO)

options.rationale: Correct: domains logically group data by area and support delegated governance.
DAX authoring is a Power BI modeling task, not a Govern-section capability.
Spark notebooks are a data-engineering tool, not a governance capability.

items.explanation: Correct: domains logically group data by area and support delegated governance.
